name: 43326 · Kenton, OH
findings: ZIP 43326 (Kenton) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43326 (Kenton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43326 (Kenton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.
